purpose: Define | as a testable distinction-preserving comparison operator without promoting it to theorem status.

operator.name: vertical_bar_operator
operator.canonical_definition: A | B is a distinction-preserving comparison between process-aspects A and B under a declared context.
operator.minimal_reading: A compared to B without collapse.

core_claim: The bar does not create a new process; it enables distinction that deviates constraint within the same process.
governance_note: Claim level C1_DEFINED / TS0 applies to the formal Compare_C candidate expression introduced by this patch. Prior induction patch MPF_VERTICAL_BAR_INDUCTION_001 holds C1_DEFINED_TO_C2_TESTABLE_CANDIDATE for the broader induction package. These are non-contradictory: this patch registers the formal candidate at TS0; the induction patch registers the testable hypothesis set.
